title: Continuous Learning Fabric verified on ICARUS main
summary: ICARUS now contains a durable continuous research-learning fabric that records immutable predictions and matured outcomes, computes empirical scorecards and calibration, catalogs historical datasets with intake metadata, runs bounded research-only training backfills, harvests native subsystem evidence, settles eligible predictions from observed prices, feeds empirical credibility back into APEX, and surfaces the learning plane through the operator UI, authenticated server API, MCP tools, Adaptive Brain registry, and research lifecycle. Exact PR-head Linux and Windows CI passed before merge, and exact-main Linux and Windows CI passed for commit 2aa8e2ff0073019600bcee4fc12c266e23651d21. The fabric cannot promote production strategies or authorize execution.
